title: Gem Properties: 60 Gemstones
subtitle: Hardness, refractive index, density and crystal system for 60 gems
description:
Physical and optical properties of 60 gem materials: species, chemical formula, crystal system, Mohs hardness, refractive index, specific gravity and colors, with a verification status for every row. From the property table in Chapter 02 of the Erebaur encyclopedia.

Data: Erebaur (https://erebaur.com), CC BY 4.0. https://erebaur.com/stones/

The data dictionary, sources and known limitations are in README.md.

resources.description: Physical and optical properties of 60 gem materials: species, chemical formula, crystal system, Mohs hardness, refractive index, specific gravity and colors, with a verification status for every row. From the property table in Chapter 02 of the Erebaur encyclopedia.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Stone or variety name as used in the encyclopedia.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Mineral species, or the material for rocks and organics.

fields.name: family
fields.description: Grouping used by the site’s filters: diamond, corundum, beryl, chrysoberyl, garnet, tourmaline, spinel, quartz, opal, jade, other, rare or organic.

fields.name: crystal_system
fields.description: Crystal system, following the MSA Handbook of Mineralogy. Qualifiers in brackets mark aggregates and microcrystalline material.

fields.name: mohs_min
fields.description: Mohs hardness, low end of the range.

fields.name: mohs_max
fields.description: Mohs hardness, high end of the range. Equal to mohs_min when a single value is given.

fields.name: ri_min
fields.description: Refractive index, low end. Empty when the material cannot be read on a refractometer.

fields.name: colors
fields.description: Colors the stone occurs in, as described in the encyclopedia.

fields.name: verification
fields.description: grade_a_sourced: values from GIA, Gems & Gemology, the MSA Handbook of Mineralogy or CIBJO. grade_a_with_exceptions: grade-A values except for the field named in notes. group_range: Mohs is the range for the whole garnet group rather than the species. unverified_secondary_source: no grade-A source found; values from secondary compilations.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: What Erebaur’s editorial review records about this row specifically. Empty when it records nothing.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Sources in Chapter 02’s list that are about this stone or that the editorial review ties to this row, separated by " | ". Not a field-by-field citation. Otherwise the URL of the chapter’s full source list.

fields.name: erebaur_url
fields.description: The stone’s own page on erebaur.com, or its row in the chapter’s property table when it has none.
